quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because loose gravel reduces tire traction.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead in the direction shown by the arrow. Driving 35 mph or slower is recommended for this curve.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights. It tells drivers that even on a green light, left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will make a sharp turn to the right and then turn sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange warning signs tell you to be careful in construction zones. This sign says that fines are higher if you drive recklessly in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed for safe driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign (with an arrow) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive with caution. Bicycles regularly cross or travel beside traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in one direction only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach a railroad crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that wet pavement makes the road slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Wait until it is clear before you proceed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the roadway. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right side.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions or hazards. This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert you to upcoming road conditions or hazards. This sign tells you that a lane is ending and traffic will merge. Be ready to move over safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Slow down and be very careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the slowest legal speed allowed. Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are heading the wrong direction and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that construction or maintenance work is coming. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is coming from the left.
The right lane ends ahead. Move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends ahead. Move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is becoming a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you to watch for traffic that may enter from an upcoming side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you that lanes ahead are shifting. Follow the new lane directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means large trucks are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means drivers from both directions can only use the shared center lane for left turns. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and construction workers. Orange signs warn drivers about construction areas. This sign alerts you that a construction zone is starting.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane below it will exit the highway and will not continue through the interchange. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to go through, or you must exit the highway.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and cars with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield the right-of-way to vehicles and pedestrians at or entering the intersection. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. These object markers warn drivers about things or areas that may be dangerous and should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down your vehicle. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can either turn left or continue straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in parking lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right. You should slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It is reserved for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn of a school nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Obey any crossing guard instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about roadwork ahead. This sign directs you to follow a detour around construction.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Left arm and hand pointing down means the driver plans to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and check that the way is clear before going.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is on top and green is on bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be alert and ready to stop.

questions.question: What is your main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If you drift onto it, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Ease back onto the road gently.

questions.question: The driver's left arm is extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, it means they plan to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows what you can do from this lane. You may turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you the right lane will close ahead. Be careful and move to another lane when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school areas. This sign means a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. A T intersection is where one road crosses another road at a right angle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs show you an alternate route because the main road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that a narrow bridge is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to exit a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign means a train crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end soon. All traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a parking rule. Where this sign is posted, you may park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be careful because the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a T intersection is coming and you should be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the maximum legal speed for that road. You should drive slower if conditions are not ideal. Bad weather or poor road conditions mean you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead who will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
